summary: Connect nine IM bots and a public AI Office to your local Harness.
description: Adds multi-bot IM channel support to DSH behind one settings surface: Feishu/Lark, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord and WhatsApp bots connect by QR code, App Manifest or credentials, each with independent workspace and session bindings. An AI Office Connector lets a public office drive the local Harness through outbound heartbeats and SSE without a public IP. Bot credentials are submitted only to the local Host and stored in the protected credential store.
